response.sql: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS account_average FROM account AS a JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), region_averages AS (SELECT region, AVG(account_average) AS region_figure FROM account_averages GROUP BY region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(region_figure) AS all_region_average FROM region_averages) SELECT r.region, r.region_figure, r.region_figure - o.all_region_average AS excess, r.region_figure / o.all_region_average AS ratio FROM region_averages AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE r.region_figure > o.all_region_average
